Four structured tracks — options, futures, macro reading and trading psychology — each with quizzes and a completion badge. Now live at /courses.
Personalised next-lesson suggestions based on what you've already studied. Live on the Learn hub — the 'Picked for you' card resumes your last lesson
Local streak tracking is live on the daily challenge. Scheduled daily or watchlist reminder notifications are not currently implemented.
